proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Under finite presentation of s and t, the stratification U = Z_0 superset Z_1 superset ... of the finite-stratify lemma is given by closed immersions Z_k to U of finite presentation (divisors locally-free-rank-r-pullback lemma). Part (1) follows since W' to W is locally given by intersecting the open W with Z_r. For part (2), let {u_1, ..., u_n} be the orbit of u; the closed subschemes Z_k are R-invariant with empty intersection, so for some k all u_i lie in Z_k and none in Z_{k + 1}. The images of Z_k to U and Z_{k + 1} to U are locally constructible (Chevalley's theorem); as u_i is a generic point of an irreducible component, there is an open neighbourhood U_i of u_i contained in Z_k without Z_{k + 1} set theoretically (properties generic-point-in-constructible lemma). In the construction of the finite-flat-over-almost-dense lemma, W is the disjoint union of the W_r with W_r inside Z_{r - 1} without Z_r and U = union of the t(s^{-1}(closures of W_r)); if u lies in t(s^{-1}(closure of W_r)) then some u_i lies in the closure of W_r, hence U_i meets W_r, hence r = k; therefore u lies in W_{k + 1} = Z_k minus Z_{k + 1} and the earlier images. (source lines 2763-2796)

core_obligations: Finite presentation of the strata: with s, t of finite presentation, the stratification of lemma-finite-stratify is given by closed immersions Z_k to U of finite presentation by divisors-lemma-locally-free-rank-r-pullback; part (1) follows as W' to W is locally given by intersecting the open W with Z_r (proof lines 2764-2770). Part (2): let {u_1, ..., u_n} be the orbit of u; the Z_k are R-invariant closed subschemes with empty intersection, so some k has u_i in Z_k and outside Z_{k + 1} for all i; the images of Z_k to U and Z_{k + 1} to U are locally constructible by morphisms-theorem-chevalley; since each u_i is a generic point of an irreducible component, properties-lemma-generic-point-in-constructible gives an open neighbourhood U_i of u_i contained in Z_k without Z_{k + 1} set theoretically (proof lines 2771-2780). Conclusion: in the construction of lemma-finite-flat-over-almost-dense-subscheme, W = coprod W_r with W_r inside Z_{r - 1} without Z_r and U = union of t(s^{-1}(closures of W_r)); if u in t(s^{-1}(closure of W_r)), then some u_i in the closure of W_r, so U_i meets W_r, which forces r = k; hence u lies in W_{k + 1} = Z_k minus Z_{k + 1} minus the union of the earlier images, i.e. u in W (proof lines 2781-2795).
proof_roadmap: Upgrade the strata: finite presentation of the closed immersions Z_k to U via the divisors pullback lemma, and read off part (1) (proof lines 2764-2770).
Find the uniform stratum index k for the whole orbit using R-invariance and the empty intersection (proof lines 2771-2774).
Produce open neighbourhoods U_i of the orbit points inside Z_k without Z_{k + 1} by Chevalley and the generic-point-in-constructible lemma (proof lines 2775-2780).
Match the stratum of u against the W_r decomposition and conclude u in W_{k + 1} inside W (proof lines 2781-2795).
